content: Rohan Deshmukh requested a home insurance quote for his new house at 45 Oak Street, Bangalore. Agent Sunita Agarwal provided a preliminary quote of ₹18,750 annually for a ₹30,00,000 sum insured, along with a draft policy document. Sunita requested a property deed, a recent utility bill, and a fire safety certificate to proceed.

action_items: Customer to review the draft policy document
Customer to provide property deed, utility bill, and fire safety certificate
